reviews.title: singular AI responses are useless
reviews.content:
When a dominant gateway to human knowledge stops pointing to sources and starts funneling every query into a single, pre-chewed summary, it shifts the balance of power. It replaces discovery with dictation.
The broader consequences of this approach highlight several key systemic issues:
1. The Death of the Independent Web
For decades, the basic "social contract" of the web was straightforward: independent writers, journalists, researchers, and hobbyists created content, and Google indexed it and sent them traffic in return.
By placing a synthesized AI answer at the top, Google extracts the information created by those publishers, presents it as its own product, and deprives those creators of the visitors they need to survive. If original creators aren't visited, they stop publishing—and the open web starves.
